adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` compute the fallback calendar ID as `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId` when `externalCalendarId` is falsy. Since `externalCalendarId` is `undefined/null` in that branch, the `.find(...)` predicate almost certainly never matches (destination calendars have a real `externalId` string), yielding `undefined`. In `deleteEvent`, that then falls back to the default (`primary`), so a booking without `externalCalendarId` in its reference would attempt deletion from the wrong calendar, leaving the event in the actual destination calendar.
